profile.name: Mohammed Nawaz Mynul Islam
profile.tagline: Full Stack Developer building fast, scalable web apps with React, Next.js & TypeScript — from enterprise dashboards to government platforms handling millions of records.

about.currentStatus: Full Stack Developer at Nano Information Technology, building and maintaining frontend + backend for enterprise and government digital platforms — including the PKSF microservice ecosystem (CMS, LMS, Accounting) and large-scale survey management systems.
about.bio: Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building fast, scalable, and responsive web applications using React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript. Skilled in frontend and backend architecture, REST API integration, SSR/SSG, performance optimization, and responsive UI development. Experienced on enterprise and government digital platforms — improving performance, handling large datasets, and collaborating in Agile/Scrum teams to deliver maintainable, user-focused solutions.
about.futureGoal: Step into a senior full-stack role leading architecture and performance work, and ship open-source tooling used by other developers.

experience.currentProject: Currently developing and maintaining the BSBR/BBS Survey Management System, building high-performance React.js interfaces, optimizing large-scale data handling, implementing secure role-based workflows, and ensuring reliable frontend-backend integration for a national-scale survey platform.
achievements: Developed reusable React.js components from complex Figma designs, reducing future feature development time by approximately 30%.
Optimized handling of millions of survey records using TanStack Query, server-side pagination, and efficient caching strategies, significantly reducing server load.
Built complex multi-step survey forms with React Hook Form and Zod, ensuring robust validation and data integrity.
Implemented secure role-based access control (RBAC) and approval workflows for structured operational processes.
Improved application reliability with high Playwright end-to-end test coverage and comprehensive API testing using Postman and Swagger.
Reduced PKSF login load time by 95% (20s → <0.63ms) through frontend optimization, asset minification, and dependency cleanup.
Engineered an automated Accounting module that synchronized LMS transactions with journal entries, auto-interest calculations, and instant balance sheet generation.
Refactored legacy PKSF applications into a modular, component-based architecture, improving maintainability and enabling faster feature delivery.
Developed borrower, loan application, disbursement, repayment scheduling, waiver, and write-off workflows for the PKSF Loan Management System.
Built and maintained employee and teacher attendance management features for the Bidyapith School Management System with REST API integration and reporting.

projects.name: PKSF — Microservice Platform
projects.description: A large-scale microservice-based platform with CMS, LMS, and Accounting services supporting loan, training, and financial workflows.
projects.details: Built and maintained three microservices: a Loan Management Service (borrower lifecycle, application → sanction → disbursement → repayment, waivers/write-offs), a Content Management Service, and an automated Accounting module that syncs real-time LMS transactions with journal entries and generates instant balance sheets. Delivered a 95% login load-time reduction and server-side pagination for large datasets.

projects.name: BSBR | BBS — Survey Management
projects.description: A high-performance national survey management system handling millions of records with role-based approval workflows.
projects.details: Engineered the frontend by converting complex Figma designs into modular, reusable React components. Optimized large-scale data handling with TanStack Query caching and server-side pagination, built robust multi-step form workflows with React Hook Form + Zod, and implemented secure role-based access control (RBAC) and approval workflows across user tiers. Achieved high Playwright E2E coverage to reduce production regressions.

projects.name: Bidyapith — School Management
projects.description: A school management system focused on employee and teacher attendance tracking and reporting.
projects.details: Developed and maintained the employee and teacher attendance management feature using React.js and REST APIs. Integrated backend APIs for attendance tracking, data submission, and real-time status updates; built responsive UI components with form handling and validation; and implemented attendance sheet generation for efficient reporting.
